what: The hero photo panels slide sideways every 6 seconds over 3s, while the photo inside a panel moves 40vw opposite to the panel and blurs 30px (outgoing), and the incoming photo starts at −40vw and clears its blur while growing to 1.2x — the panel and photo move different distances for a deep parallax, and the screen smears heavily during the change. Clicking a dot goes to that slide (going back runs in reverse)

options.every: Tempo for moving to the next section (s), default 6
options.shift: Distance (vw) the photo moves opposite the panel, default 40
options.blur: Blur of photos entering and leaving (px), default 30
options.zoom: Photo scale of the active section, default 1.2
options.[data-fx-part=slide]·[data-fx-part=media: Photo panel · image that pushes and blurs inside it
options.[data-fx-part=dots]: If present, creates a dot button for each section (lit dot .is-active)
options.fx:next·fx:prev: Fire this event on an element to jump straight to the next or previous section

note: The original is Swiper 8 (loop · speed 3000 · autoplay 6000 · no drag) with a 3s transform·filter transition on each active/prev/next photo — the same tempo is produced with GSAP and no Swiper. The site copy (in the library folder) is built with Swiper 8.4.7, the same as the original.

from.where: index.html .me-hero__slide — original #topHeroSlide(.swiper-slide[class*=-active] img: translateX(0) scale(1.2) blur(0) · -prev: translateX(40vw) blur(30px) · -next: translateX(-40vw) blur(30px) · transition 3s)
